UpperCaseScheme - Class in p
An uppercase scheme name. URL schemes are case-insensitive.
MixedCaseScheme - Class in p
A mixed-case scheme name.
ProtocolRelative - Class in p
A protocol-relative URL, which names the same server as the containing page.
FtpScheme - Class in p
A scheme other than "http" and "https".
MailtoScheme - Class in p
A "mailto" URL, which has no path at all.
FileScheme - Class in p
A "file" URL, which is already in the form that the output uses.
Local - Class in p
A local file, for comparison.
